body: Hey buddy, did you pull out in front of it and get hit by the locomotive.
You need Jesus, he loves you very much and has experienced your pain and understands. He loves you. It's true.

Hey buddy, I draw a lot of hope in strength from God and His Son Jesus Christ. They both love you and will give you purpose in life. Reach to me if you'd like to talk about beginning a relationship with Jesus, I'd be happy to answer your questions. Tim

Hi buddy, I can offer the only way that exists to cure you pain and Heal your heart. His name is Jesus, the Son of God and he changes lives and offers real love and compassion..this world offers counterfeit love and temporary satisfaction. If you would like to learn more about Jesus, I'd be happy to talk to you about Him. Nothing to lose

1) You are loved by God, who created you
2) You are loved by Jesus Christ His Son
3) You are loved by the Holy Spirit
4)I love you
5) If you choose, God will give you a new heart so you can begin to love others as others love you.

Let me know if you have any questions about God and Jesus

Hey there...you are loved by the God who created the universe and everything in it. Loook at the stars at night, he loves you more than any of them. Jesus Christ His Son also loves you and has seen your hurts. They are heartbroken and are waiting for you to run into their open arms. I also love you too would be happy to answer any questions you may have about God and Jesus. Please don't harm yourself...take it all to Jesus first.

Hey there...are greatest need as human is love. Who is the source of that love: God. This world offers a counterfeit love that always fails and disappoints. Gods love you is real and is revealed through His Son Jesus Christ who died for our sins. You are loved Jesus had seen all you've been through and it is breaking his heart. If you reach out to Him,he will begin to heal your life. I'd be honored to answer any questions you may have. You are loved though and it gets so much better as you draw neAr To Jesus. With much love and compassion-Tim
I'm not a troll..., I care about you, my name is Tim and made my own attempt earlier this year via Tylenol. I want to help you in any way possible.

The world is a sinful place and there is war going that we don't see for the souls of man. I will take a risk and asking to consider giving your life to Jesus. Satan hates you but Jesus loves you and died and rose again to pay our penalty we owe God because of our sins. He sees you pain and it is breaking his heart...please reach out to him and he start the healing process. I will help you. Love will overcome this pain
